data_kind: authored documentation-derived repair procedures and synthetic evaluation fixtures
inclusion: Historical autonomous repair failure in project reports; no routine start/restart, OOM, DNS or disk-full examples.
evaluation_limit: Tests retrieval and tool contracts. Inputs are unseen variations of known fault families, not unseen families; no proof of LLM repair improvement.
source_policy: Original summaries and tool mappings; no copied public dataset, official documentation text or production logs.
